source.title: NRCS SNOTEL daily snow water equivalent, snow depth and air temperature (AWDB REST API), station annual snowfall derived for the snowfall heat map
source.note: Public domain (US government work, USDA NRCS National Water and Climate Center). Derived, not measured: SNOTEL measures snow water equivalent and depth, not snowfall. Daily new snow = daily SWE gain / new snow density (the SNOW-17 step HCN = PX / DHN), never below the daily depth gain, with the climate.snotel thresholds (SWE gain 0.1 to 6.0 in, depth spike 40.0 in, cap 60.0 in, rain snow threshold 1.0 C). Density: the station's own monthly median storm density, else the anderson_1976 estimate from the station's daily mean air temperature (TAVG). Annual figure: the median of the water year totals 2011 to 2025; a year counts when Nov to Apr have 90% of their days with data, and a station needs 8 such years. Values describe the station elevation.
